title: Martial Arts: Deft Strikes
categories: Passives that gain benefits at higher levels
html:
Martial Arts: Deft Strikes is a Monk passive feature that raises the minimum damage dealt with Monk weapons and unarmed attacks to 1d4⁠⁠Bludgeoning.

Description

Attacks with Monk Weapons and unarmed attacks deal 1d4⁠⁠Bludgeoning damage, unless their normal damage is higher.

At higher levels

  • At Monk Level 3, the damage increases to 1d6⁠⁠Bludgeoning.
  • At Monk Level 9, the damage increases to 1d8⁠⁠Bludgeoning.

How to learn

Classes:

  • Class level 1: Monk

Used by creatures:

  • Mask of Terror (The Blushing Mermaid), Sina'zith

Notes

  • Monk weapons will deal whatever damage type they normally are, not bludgeoning. For example, a level 9 Monk will deal 1d8⁠⁠Piercing damage with a shortsword.
  • Surprisingly, at 9th this ability is capable to upgrade even hand crossbows to 1d8⁠⁠Piercing, as long as the character is proficient with them.
  • This ability does not upgrade the damage die for weapons dealing multi-dice damage, such as  Sickle (Redcap),  Sickle of BOOOAL, and  Twisted Oak Crook.
